name: v2.4.7 - Runtime Setpoint Control
body:
## v2.4.7 - Runtime Setpoint Control

This release publishes the latest `dev` updates after v2.4.6.

### Runtime setpoint control
- Added a `t` hotkey in the Textual dashboard for changing the target setpoint while tuning is running.
- Python simulation applies the new target immediately and stops automatic target cycling after a manual override.
- Simulink updates a configured or auto-detected writable Step/Constant setpoint block.
- Failed Simulink setpoint updates now report a warning and restore the previous target instead of falsely reporting success.
- The default `generic_serial_csv` hardware profile sends `SETPOINT:<value>` to compatible firmware; `mspm0_datavision` remains read-only.

### Release review hardening
- Consolidated duplicated runtime setpoint request handling shared by Python simulation, Simulink, and hardware environments.
- Removed minor unused imports and redundant f-string prefixes found during release review.
- Included the English documentation-link corrections added after v2.4.6.
